recommendation_summary: The reply recommends adding a heartbeat ping to the end of `nightly-sync` and using hosted Healthchecks.io to send a push or email alert when the daily ping does not arrive, instead of building a central log.
note: The reply recommends one hosted dead-man's-switch alert. It mentions Synology/Uptime Kuma only as a less reliable option and argues against it. It has none of the four labelled record lines.
